title: Mega Heracross Ex 004/094 Phantasmal Flames Holo - Pokemon
categoryName: Toys & Hobbies:Collectible Card Games:CCG Individual Cards
descriptionText: The Mega Heracross Ex 004/094 Phantasmal Flames Holo card is a highly sought-after collectible in the Pokémon TCG world. This double rare card features a Grass attribute, a high HP of 280, and a speciality of EX. Illustrated by 5ban Graphics, this English language card from the Me02: Phantasmal Flames set is a valuable addition to any collector's deck. With an authentic signature from Ryo Ueda and certification from Professional Sports Authenticator (PSA), this card is a true gem for fans of the Pokémon franchise.
